steps.title: Prepare growth medium
steps.instruction: Mix 880 ml DMEM (high glucose) with 100 ml fetal bovine serum, 10 ml 10 mM non‑essential amino acids, 10 ml 100× Penicillin/Streptomycin, and 3.7 g sodium bicarbonate. Adjust pH to 7.4 and sterilize by passing through a 0.22 µm filter cup.

steps.title: Prepare maintenance medium
steps.instruction: Combine 946 ml SFM4MegaVir with 4 ml 250× cholesterol lipid concentrate, 20 ml 100× GlutaMAX‑I, 10 ml 100 mM sodium pyruvate, 10 ml 10 mM non‑essential amino acids, 10 ml 100× Penicillin/Streptomycin, and 2.95 g sodium bicarbonate. Adjust pH to 7.4 and sterilize through a 0.22 µm filter cup.

steps.title: Prepare 1x Trypsin‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Dilute 10 ml of 10× Trypsin‑EDTA (0.5 %) with 90 ml of 1× PBS (pH 7.4).

steps.title: Prepare 1x PBS (pH 7.4)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 8.006 g NaCl, 0.201 g KCl, 0.765 g Na₂HPO₄·2H₂O, and 0.191 g KH₂PO₄ in double‑distilled water, adjust pH to 7.4, bring volume to 1 L and autoclave.

steps.title: Prepare 1x TNE buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 7.88 g Tris‑HCl, 5.844 g NaCl, and 0.037 g EDTA in double‑distilled water, adjust pH to 7.4, bring volume to 1 L and autoclave.

steps.title: Prepare 60 % sucrose solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 300 g sucrose powder in 1× TNE buffer and adjust final volume to 500 ml.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M carbonate‑bicarbonate buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.59 g Na₂CO₃ and 2.94 g NaHCO₃ in double‑distilled water, adjust volume to 500 ml (pH ≈ 9.6).

steps.title: Prepare 1 % BSA solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 g BSA heat‑shock fraction in 1× PBS and bring volume to 500 ml.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 % PBS‑T
steps.instruction: Mix 1 ml Tween‑20 with 999 ml 1× PBS.

steps.title: Prepare 2 N H₂SO₄
steps.instruction: Slowly add 28.055 ml concentrated H₂SO₄ to 125 ml double‑distilled water, then bring final volume to 500 ml.

steps.title: Grow COS‑1 cells (Method I)
steps.instruction: Culture COS‑1 cells in growth medium in 20 T‑150 flasks until they reach 90‑95 % confluence at 37 °C, humidified 5 % CO₂. Passage at a 1:2 split ratio for at least two consecutive days before use.

steps.title: Harvest cells for electroporation
steps.instruction: Decant medium, wash cells with 20 ml PBS, add 3 ml warm trypsin per flask, rock gently, remove excess trypsin leaving ~1 ml, incubate at 37 °C for 2‑3 min, lightly tap flask to dislodge cells, resuspend in 10 ml warm growth medium, rinse flask, collect cells into a 50 ml conical tube on ice.

steps.title: Pellet and wash cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 400 × g, 4 °C for 2 min; discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 10 ml ice‑cold PBS, centrifuge again at 400 × g, 4 °C for 2 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in ice‑cold PBS at 0.75 ml per flask, pipette up/down to break clumps.

steps.title: Count and adjust cell density
steps.instruction: Perform a 1:100 dilution in 0.5 % Trypan blue, count with a hemocytometer, and adjust the suspension to 1.5 × 10⁷ cells/ml in ice‑cold PBS.

steps.title: Set up electroporation
steps.instruction: Add 30 µg plasmid DNA (≤ 50 µl) to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube, gently tap, add 500 µl cell suspension, transfer mixture to an ice‑cold 0.4 cm gap cuvette, avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Electroporate at 250 V and 975 µF (target time constant 28‑32 ms). Include no‑DNA control electroporations to verify time constant. After electroporation keep cuvettes at room temperature ≤ 10 min before recovery.

steps.title: Recover electroporated cells
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl pre‑warmed growth medium to each cuvette, gently pipette with a slender 1 ml tip, seed the entire 1 ml mixture into a pre‑warmed T‑150 flask containing 25 ml pre‑warmed growth medium, rock gently to disperse.

steps.title: Post‑electroporation incubation
steps.instruction: Allow cells to recover for 6‑12 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, then replace growth medium with 50 ml pre‑warmed maintenance medium.

steps.title: VLP secretion incubation
steps.instruction: Transfer flasks to a humidified 5 % CO₂ incubator set to 28 °C. Monitor medium color daily; pink‑red indicates pH 7.2, yellow‑orange indicates pH < 7. If acidic, add 400‑500 µl of 5 % sodium bicarbonate solution per flask dropwise until color returns to pink‑red.

steps.title: Harvest supernatant (repeated)
steps.instruction: Five days after electroporation, collect culture supernatant, replace with fresh maintenance medium. Repeat harvest and re‑feeding every 5 days for 4‑6 cycles while cells remain healthy. Clarify each harvest by centrifugation at 10,000 × g, 4 °C for 30 min; store clarified supernatant at 4 °C (or at –80 °C if processing will be delayed > 2‑3 weeks).

steps.title: Alternative: Stable VLP expression
steps.instruction: Thaw one vial of COS‑1 cells stably expressing DENV VLPs in a 37 °C water bath, add to 50 ml warm growth medium, centrifuge 400 × g, 2 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 25 ml warm growth medium, seed into a T‑150 flask, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Add G418 to 500 µg/ml the next day. Expand cells to 90‑95 % confluence, then repeat the trypsinization, washing, and seeding steps described above, maintaining G418 (500 µg/ml) in all media. When 20 T‑150 flasks reach confluence, replace growth medium with 50 ml maintenance medium and shift incubator to 28 °C, 5 % CO₂. Harvest and re‑feed supernatant every 5 days as described for Method I.

steps.title: Concentrate harvested supernatant (Day 1)
steps.instruction: Load 1 L clarified supernatant onto a 100 kDa MWCO centrifugal filter (Amicon Ultra‑15) and spin at 5,000 × g, 4 °C. Perform an initial 30‑min spin, then continue until the volume is reduced ≈ 50‑fold. Keep the concentrate at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Filter and load sucrose cushion (Day 2)
steps.instruction: Pass the concentrated supernatant through a 0.22 µm syringe filter. Dilute 60 % (w/v) sucrose to 20 % (w/v) with TNE buffer and filter‑sterilize. In a 25 × 89 mm ultracentrifuge tube, add 15 ml 20 % sucrose, layer 20 ml concentrated supernatant using a 25 ml pipette, then add 80‑100 µl 100 % glycerol. Tilt tube at 35°, dispense slowly (half filler speed, partial trigger). Centrifuge at 140,000 × g, 4 °C for 16 h in a Beckman SW28 rotor.

steps.title: Prepare sucrose gradient (Day 3)
steps.instruction: Decant the sucrose cushion, wick tube on Kimwipes for 5‑15 min, add 250 µl TNE to the pellet, cover with Parafilm and let soften overnight at 4 °C. Meanwhile, prepare 5 %, 10 %, 15 %, 20 %, and 25 % (w/v) sucrose solutions in TNE by diluting the 60 % stock; filter‑sterilize each. In a 14 × 89 mm ultracentrifuge tube, layer 2 ml of 25 % sucrose, then 2 ml each of 20 %, 15 %, 10 %, and 5 % sucrose (densest at bottom). Cover with Parafilm and let stand undisturbed overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Coat ELISA plate (Day 3)
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl per well of rabbit anti‑DENV‑2 VLP hyper‑immune serum diluted 1:500 in carbonate‑bicarbonate buffer to a flat‑bottom 96‑well plate. Incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Load gradient and centrifuge (Day 4)
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the VLP pellet, transfer to a 1.5 ml tube, spin at 16,000 × g, 4 °C for 2 min; repeat supernatant transfer and spin. Layer the VLP suspension onto the prepared 5‑25 % sucrose gradient. Centrifuge at 107,000 × g, 4 °C for 3 h in a Beckman SW41 rotor (slow acceleration, no brake).

steps.title: Collect gradient fractions
steps.instruction: Using a 1 ml pipette tip, collect 500 µl fractions from top to bottom, changing tips between fractions, and keep fractions at 4 °C.

steps.title: Perform antigen‑capture ELISA
steps.instruction: Take the pre‑coated plate (Day 3). Dump coating solution, tap dry. Add 200 µl per well of 1 % BSA blocking buffer, incubate 1 h at 37 °C. Remove block, tap dry. Add 50 µl per well of each fraction diluted 1:50 in blocking buffer, incubate 1 h at 37 °C. Wash 5× with 200 µl per well 0.1 % PBS‑T, tapping between washes. Add 50 µl per well anti‑DENV‑2 MHIAF diluted 1:2,000 in blocking buffer, incubate 1 h at 37 °C. Wash 5× as before. Add 50 µl per well HRP‑conjugated goat anti‑mouse IgG diluted 1:5,000 in blocking buffer, incubate 1 h at 37 °C. Wash 10× with 200 µl per well 0.1 % PBS‑T. Add 50 µl per well TMB substrate, incubate at room temperature 10 min. Add 50 µl per well 2 N H₂SO₄ to stop. Read absorbance at 450 nm. Identify peak OD fractions (typically 4‑7).

steps.title: Pool peak fractions and cushion
steps.instruction: Pool the peak fractions, transfer to a new 14 × 89 mm ultracentrifuge tube, adjust volume to 10 ml with TNE, add 80‑100 µl 100 % glycerol.

steps.title: Final ultracentrifugation (Day 4)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge pooled fractions at 270,000 × g, 4 °C for 4 h in a Beckman SW41 rotor. Decant sucrose, wick tube for 5‑15 min, add 200 µl TNE to pellet, cover with Parafilm, and let soften overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend and quantify VLPs (Day 5)
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the VLP pellet, determine total protein concentration using the Bio‑Rad protein assay, aliquot into microcentrifuge tubes, and store at –80 °C until use.
